notes.title: Nordhold BETA 1.0.6 is Live – New Banner, Relics & Fixes!
notes.content:
[h1]🛠️ Nordhold 1.0.6 is live on the BETA – Come test the latest update![/h1]

[h2]A Big Beta Update is Here – New Banner, Relics, and More![/h2]
The Nordhold Beta just got a major update: Version 1.0.6 is now live and ready for testing!
This is a big step forward for the game – new content, balance tweaks, bug fixes, performance improvements – and we need YOU to help us test it.

[h2]⚠️ Reminder: This is a BETA – Expect Bugs![/h2]
The beta gives you early access to features that aren’t in the main game yet. It’s an experimental space – so expect the unexpected, and please share your feedback! Your insights will help us make Nordhold even better.

[h2]🔓 How to Join:[/h2]
[*] Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/7EUUNfNPux][b]Nordhold Discord server[/b][/url]
[*] React with the 🪓 emoji in the [b]#beta-access[/b] channel
[*] You’ll automatically get the Beta role and access to the #beta-chat where you’ll find instructions in the last pinned message

[h2]📋 Beta Patch Notes 1.0.6:[/h2]

[h3]New / Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] NEW Mortar Banner: [b]Crescendo[/b] has been replaced
[*] 7 NEW Relics added
[*] [b]Arcane Rift[/b] (Uni, War Tree, Spell Damage+) now increases spell damage multiplicatively
[/list]

[h3]Major Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved leaderboard visibility, especially for first-time players
[*] Fixed bugs in leaderboard entries (overwriting results, etc.)
[*] Further optimized Endless Spell Scaling to reduce excessive values
[*] Fixed issues with saving tower upgrade prices
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Marks of Ascension[/b] (Rare Relic) removed from loot pool for the first 9 waves
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Volcano Mortar VFX optimized, resulting in noticeable performance improvements
[*] General performance improvements
[*] Fixed color coding of the Runeforge icon (yellow when all 4 upgrades are completed)
[*] Camera movement speed is now adjustable separately for mouse and keyboard/WASD controls in settings
[*] Fixed auto-banish for [i]Tempest-Stopper[/i] (Tornado Banner)
[*] Fixed some Fusion/Unique Banner exploits
[*] Fixed issues with self-healing enemy HP in waves 80+
[*] Relic overlay now correctly displays underneath the eye symbol
[*] Shift-click now toggles Trading Post stack size between min and max
[*] ESC key now works for additional use cases (e.g., opening settings in title screen)
[*] Various minor bug fixes
[/list]

Your feedback in Discord will be incredibly valuable!

[h2]🙏 Thank You for Helping Us Build a Better Nordhold![/h2]

[i]PS: You still need to own the game on Steam to access the beta branch.[/i]

notes.title: NEW Season / NEW Banner System / Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.0.5[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063720/ffc8a52ee93807843f8d54695c0dadc420a126a8.png[/img]

With this patch, we're delivering several milestone elements from our planned roadmap (see below), including:
[olist]
[*] launch a new season!
[*] add a new banner system
[*] deliver significant QoL and bug fixes!
[/olist]

[h3]New / Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]GENERALIST BANNER SYSTEM:[/b] Choose 2 banners from 5 different tower types and earn a powerful specialization as a reward!  
[*] [b]NEW SEASON:[/b] A new season has begun – many things have changed. You can still view the results of the last season. 
The following badges are awarded for the previous season:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063720/42df58af2870b62a668d53b2a35f2f39306d7b4c.png[/img]
[*] [b]Endless Mode Scaling Modifiers:[/b] Enemies gain special resistance scaling over time. In turn, spell base damage now scales as well.  
[*] Shadow Tornados (Tornado x Shadow Fusion) now trigger [i]Darkness[/i] (Shadow Banner effect), but no longer trigger [i]Overdose[/i] (Shadow Banner)  
[*] Frost spells now override Frost Tower effects (and cannot be overwritten by Frost Towers)  
[*] Reroll function for Hero Choice added via a new Hero Tower Meta Perk  
[*] Added button to open chests (for cases where visibility is blocked)  
[*] City-building icons now change color based on the upgrade completion of their respective building  
[/list]

[h3]Major bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed special case of invisible chests  
[*] Fixed bug preventing spells from being triggered  
[*] Improved savegame stability  
[*] Fixed rare bug in later waves where bosses could become immortal
[*] Fixed rare bug in later waves where health bars disappeared
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Doom Scattering[/b] (Raven x Tornado Fusion):  
  Initial: 20% → 30%  
  Banner upgrades: 6/8/14% → 9/12/21%  
[*] [b]Clinking Mastery[/b] (Raven x Frost Fusion):  
  Initial: 200% → 300%  
  Banner upgrades: 60/80/140% → 90/120/210%  
[*] [b]Precision Shots[/b] (Arrow x Mortar Fusion):  
  Initial: 90% → 120%  
  Banner upgrades: 30/40/70% → 40/55/95%  
[*] [b]Shadow Tornado[/b] (Tornado x Shadow Fusion):  
  Duration: 200 → 130  
  Banner Duration: 20/30/40 → 9/12/21  
  Damage: 400% → 200%  
  Banner Damage: 120/160/280% → 60/80/140%  
[*] [b]Squall[/b] (Tornado Banner):  
  Initial: +73/87/130 → +90/120/210%  
  Upgrades: +43/57/100 → +60/80/140%  
[*] [b]Stormbringer[/b] (Tornado Banner): +18/24/42% → +21/28/50%  
[*] [b]Wide Blast[/b] (Volcano Mortar Banner): +15/20/35% → +20/27/47%  
[*] [b]Runestone Tower[/b] Fire Rate: 7 → 6  
[*] [b]Scorching[/b] (Runestone x Tornado Fusion):  
  Initial: 40% → 30%  
  Banner upgrades: 12/16/28% → 9/12/21%  
[*] [b]Spiral of Pain[/b] (Shadow x Tornado Fusion):  
  Initial: 30% → 40%  
  Banner upgrades: 9/12/21% → 12/16/28%  
[*] [b]Prism[/b] damage transfer from previous towers: 70% → 60%  
[*] [b]Frost Tower:[/b]  
  Max Slow Amount: 80% → 75%  
  Freeze immunity after being frozen: 0.5s → 1s  
[*] [b]Frost Magician[/b] Global Cooldown: 15s → 20s  
[*] Auto-banish of irrelevant perks after entering Endless Mode (e.g. more branching possible)  
[*] Removed downside from [i]Guild Obligation[/i] (no longer disables Goldmine)  
[*] Removed downside from [i]The One Standard[/i] (Fusions/Uniques no longer restricted)  
[*] [b]Best Selection[/b] (University, Luck Tree): Chance for banners in chests: 5x → 10x  
[*] [b]Path of Bounty:[/b] Next Boss HP Boost: 30% → 50%  
[*] Hero Tower Specializations now grant more of the original spell damage: 50% → 70%  
[*] [b]Greedgem[/b] (Rare Relic): +100% → +200%  
[*] [b]Seal of Constancy[/b] and [b]Golden Incentive[/b] (Common Relics) have swapped downsides  
[*] [b]Mill Specializations[/b] buffed: +4 Wheat per Worker, +20 passive Wheat production  
[*] [b]All other Resource Building Specializations[/b] buffed: +2 per Worker  
[*] Buffed University Perks:  
  [i]Luck Tree:[/i] Market rerolls: 2 → 3  
  [i]War Tree:[/i] Enemy Analysis: +80% → +100% crit damage  
  [i]Economy Tree:[/i]  
  - Trade Networks: 2 → 3 gold per ship  
  - Golden Era: 60 → 80 gold per wave  
  - Conservation: 20% → 30% worker cost reduction  
  - Honey Ale: 40% → 60% beer bonus productivity  
[*] [b]Starter Bonuses to choose, when you start a new run:[/b]  
  Wheat: 40 → 50  
  Stone: 50 → 55  
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Performance optimization (especially with Runestone–Prism chains)  
[*] Trade stack size in the Trading Post can now exceed 100  
[*] Forges now display which towers are being buffed  
[*] Specialized Workshop now directly shows which tower will be affected  
[*] Improved perk refresh timing  
[*] Fixed bug where [i]Enemy Bane[/i] achievement didn’t count on all difficulties  
[*] [i]Clearing Master[/i] (Workshop Spec) now shows its effect when hovering over build resources  
[*] 0-gold tower upgrades are now purchasable even when using [i]Final Rags[/i] (debt relic)  
[*] VFX reduction setting now affects all visual effects

The free prologue Nordhold: Origins is here, challenging you to defend your Castle against 20 intense waves of enemies!

[h2]Master the art of strategy [/h2]
Face 20 relentless waves of enemies in a one-of-a-kind tower defense challenge that will put your tactical skills to the ultimate test. Choose from 5 unique towers, each with an extensive upgrade system, allowing you to tailor your defenses to crush even the most formidable foes.

[h2]Grow your Kingdom[/h2]
You’ll need a robust economy to fuel your war efforts. Build and expand your medieval Nordic Castle, balancing resource management with the relentless need for stronger defenses.

Test your skills globally or with friends in our competitive ranking system. 
Can you achieve the coveted Valhalla rank?
